items.title: Confirm Loop write surfaces
items.description: Determine whether internal or newly released APIs can create workspaces, pages, blocks, and components. Separate governance APIs from content mutation APIs.

items.title: Create representative Notion fixture
items.description: Build a sanitized workspace with nested pages, databases, two-way relations, formulas, rollups, views, comments, files, mentions, synced blocks, and unsupported embeds.

items.title: Define canonical graph schema
items.description: Specify stable entities, typed properties, block payloads, assets, source IDs, target IDs, edges, and migration status fields.

items.title: Implement source compatibility scanner
items.description: Read a companion Notion API snapshot and export data, inventory every entity, and classify expected fidelity before writing target content.

items.title: Prototype Loop execution adapter
items.description: Test a supported internal action surface if available; otherwise prototype user-approved rich HTML insertion and record its fidelity and failure modes.

items.title: Implement two-pass identity mapping
items.description: Create target objects, persist source-to-target IDs, then resolve links, relations, backlinks, and attachment references.

items.title: Evaluate Microsoft 365 database mappings
items.description: Compare Loop tables, Microsoft Lists, Planner, calculated columns, Power Automate, and custom components for common Notion database patterns.

items.title: Design agent transformation harness
items.description: Define strict prompts, structured input and output schemas, allowed transformation classes, approval boundaries, and deterministic validators.

items.title: Add prompt injection defenses
items.description: Treat source pages as untrusted data, isolate instructions, constrain tool access, validate outputs, and log agent decisions.

items.title: Build migration validation report
items.description: Report migrated, transformed, skipped, failed, and manually required entities with relation and link integrity checks.

items.title: Evaluate Adaptive Card bridge
items.description: Test whether externally backed Adaptive Card-based Loop components provide useful transition value for unsupported Notion databases.

items.title: Define pilot success metrics
items.description: Choose fidelity, migration time, manual correction, resume reliability, and Loop adoption measurements for the intern project demo.

items.title: Select stack and create DDD scaffold
items.description: Choose the implementation language and runtime, then create feature-first modules with domain, application, infrastructure, and presentation layers inside each feature.

items.title: Harden untrusted migration inputs
items.description: Bound directory and ZIP ingestion, reject unsafe and duplicate source paths before extraction, isolate generated filenames from source IDs, clean stale package pages, and constrain static serving to the resolved output root.

items.title: Configure read-only Notion integration
items.description: Create an internal integration with Read content capability, connect the migration root and related databases, and provide the token only through the localhost process-memory session.

items.title: Implement live Notion API collector
items.description: Traverse the connected workspace through the Notion API and emit the existing companion snapshot schema with pages, database schemas, rows, relations, formulas, rollups, and unsupported-block metadata.

items.title: Add CI quality gate
items.description: Run the locked Node.js 24 install, type-check, tests, build, demo, and generated-file checks for pull requests to main and pushes to main without publishing generated output.

items.title: Deploy sanitized public demo
items.description: Generate a fresh GitHub Pages artifact only from the declared synthetic fixture, remove local paths and privacy patterns, preserve local migrate behavior, and gate main-only deployment on the existing validation job.

items.title: Build localhost connection wizard
items.description: Provide a separate 127.0.0.1 start-first wizard with validated ZIP metadata or Notion API setup, Microsoft identifiers and targets, process-memory secret storage, explicit deletion, and public demo isolation.

items.title: Add bounded ZIP acquisition
items.description: Stream selected ZIP bytes through a localhost-only bounded endpoint, reuse archive size and traversal protections, and connect the uploaded source to existing workspace ingestion without persisting the archive.

items.title: Implement Microsoft delegated login
items.description: Use the validated tenant and client IDs for a loopback delegated login, request least-privilege Graph consent, and keep access and refresh tokens inside the same process-memory deletion boundary.
